text: Some people are to be reasoned, some flattered, some intimidated, and some teased into a thing; but, in general, all are to be brought into it at last, if skillfully applied to, properly managed, and indefatigably attacked in their several weak places.
author: Philip Stanhope, 4th Earl of Chesterfield
locator: Letter LXXI, to his son, London, May 22, Old Style 1749
